title: Our Philosophy
desc: Aldo Leopold's “land ethic”: the soil, water, plants, and animals of the Harsimus Branch as a community, with the public as its stewards.

title: Living with the Land
desc: A self-seeded upland forest running through downtown Jersey City, preserved and opened to residents for sensitive reuse.

title: Light Touch
desc: Preserve the Embankment's historic integrity while minimizing disturbance to its thriving ecosystems.

title: Continuous Corridor
desc: Connected rail rights-of-way that let the East Coast Greenway pass entirely off-road through Jersey City.

title: Stepping Stone Landscapes
desc: Small habitat patches that bridge larger ecosystems, from red-tailed hawks to monarch butterflies.

title: Ecological Path
desc: Pathways routed through lower-productivity zones, guided by Rutgers' research on the Embankment's ecology.

title: Phase 1: Blocks 1 & 2 (2027)
desc: The first two blocks of the Embankment Vision, establishing a critical East Coast Greenway connection through Jersey City.

title: Block 1: Plaza, Promenade, and Pedestrian Bridge
desc: An entrance plaza, a 30-foot-wide promenade, and Jersey City's first mass timber pedestrian bridge.

title: Block 2: Discovery Play, Rest and Research, Field Station
desc: A timber boardwalk winding through the Embankment's forest and meadow habitats.

title: Discovery Play
desc: A nature-based timber play area nestled among the trees, connected by natural mulch trails.

title: Rest and Research Area
desc: A quiet rest area beside Rutgers' ecological research zone, with seating from salvaged Embankment stones.

title: Field Station
desc: A covered outdoor classroom at the meadow's edge, with planting shelves for propagating native plants.

title: Future Phases: Forest Conservation Trail
desc: Blocks 3 through 6 as protected forest, with a winding trail through areas of lower ecological productivity.

title: Land Bridges
desc: Carbon-negative mass timber bridges that carry both people and wildlife across the streets.

title: A Green Network
desc: The Harsimus Branch as a link in an off-road East Coast Greenway route through Hudson County.

title: East Coast Greenway Route in Jersey City
desc: 3,000 miles of people-powered trails from Maine to Florida, entering Jersey City through the Bergen Arches.

title: Crossroads
desc: A network of Hudson County trails along industrial rights-of-way, with the East Coast Greenway as its spine.

title: Harsimus Branch and Embankment Public Access
desc: ADA access at each neighborhood the greenway borders, with grand bike ramps at each end.

title: Creating Our Sustainable Future
desc: Artists' creativity and voices woven into the Embankment vision.
